changes: First Modwerk release for Digitakt I OS 1.53 and 1.54, on Core 2.1. Snap native SRC start, end and loop markers to nearby zero crossings. In the normal recording editor, apply an adjustable loop crossfade with one-level undo.

Compatibility flag only: marked as incompatible with digimono, because both patch the same firmware code (0x401848dc on OS 1.53, 0x40184bdc on 1.54). The site already refused the pair for overlapping firmware changes; it now names the conflict too. Pinned firmware code is unchanged.
